howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get your favorite {platform} media in 5 effortless steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Open {platform} and navigate to the public post, reel, or carousel you wish to download.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Tap the three dots (...) or share icon on the post and select 'Copy Link'.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Paste the copied URL into the search box above and click 'Search Media'.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Preview the photos or videos and check or uncheck the specific items you want to keep.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Download individual files, bundle selected items into a single ZIP, or convert photos to PDF.

limits.title: Operational Limits & Guarantees
limits.subtitle: Designed with transparency, speed, and privacy in mind.
limits.limit1Desc: We do not access or bypass private accounts, login gates, or stories requiring authentication.
limits.limit2Desc: To guarantee instantaneous streaming without timeouts, ZIP and PDF bundles are capped at 20 items per batch.
limits.limit3Desc: Media streams directly from origin to your browser. No photos, videos, or user data are stored on our servers.
limits.limit4Desc: Soft in-memory rate limiting prevents spamming and ensures equal server availability for all visitors.
